This is a local spatial concept, not tested collision, water-state transitions, rescue success or assurance that optional lower records survive every route.

Exactly two empty open transport boxes sit on lift; independent dry permanent stairs reach an open sunlit surface doorway. Return is visually independent of lift. Rear water stays behind railing; abstract registry marks and box presence do not prove responsibility or inventory capacity.

Four phases read as closed/latched, closed/unlatched, partly open and fully open with empty dry interior. Treat as high-level storyboard only; reauthor latch attachment and hinge sweep before mechanical animation or collision use. Opening alone establishes no person rescue/consent.
